title: Chainer Discovers the Mirari
summary: Chainer finds Karn's enigmatic probe and presents it to the Cabal Patriarch, setting the Otarian struggle in motion.
narrative: In an abandoned mansion near Cabal City, the young dementia caster Chainer encountered the Mirari. He delivered it to the First rather than claiming the device for himself.

The Patriarch placed the object among the Cabal's treasures and made it a prize, attracting champions and ambitious powers into a struggle for possession. Its origin as Karn's probe would be revealed only later.
